claim: Approval fell back to a guessed highest version when lineage was ambiguous.
evidence: Two Artifacts without Iterations still produced an approval.
impact: Approval could bind to the wrong final version.
required_action: Require unambiguous iteration lineage for approval.

prevention.action: Use lineage_final_artifact and reject all lineage errors.
prevention.fallback_reason: Natural order only supports incomplete non-approval runtime snapshots.
